title: Community Discord SYN-data edge-flow v2b
summary: Экспериментальная v2b-попытка для Discord Flatpak/native webapp: сохраняет v2 phase-zero SYN-data/send profiles, добавляет discordapp.com/www.discordapp.com в Discord hostlist-профили и фиксирует диагностическую лестницу SYN-SENT -> ESTAB -> TLS.
intendedFor: ручная проверка Discord Linux/Flatpak, когда update-check уже проходит, но main webapp грузит https://discordapp.com/app и получает ERR_TIMED_OUT
ситуация, где v2 перевёл Discord edge socket с SYN-SENT/connect timeout на ESTAB/TLS ClientHello timeout
owner-selects во вкладке Стратегии; не включается автоматически
notes: v2 owner test showed a useful phase shift: Discord Flatpak reached ESTAB on 162.159.130.233:443, then timed out after TLS ClientHello while loading https://discordapp.com/app.
This v2b seed keeps the explicit phase-zero branch from v2 and adds discordapp.com/www.discordapp.com to the Discord host/SNI profiles observed from the Flatpak webapp URL.
Phase-zero helped TCP, but host/SNI phase was still missing or insufficient in v2; v2b is a narrow hostlist experiment, not a route/TUN replacement.
The Windows --wf-* and WinDivert raw parts are not copied; Linux nftables still decides which packets enter NFQUEUE.
If v2b still reaches ESTAB + TLS ClientHello but never ServerHello/HTTP, the next suspect is strategy effectiveness at TLS phase or a route/tunnel/TUN lane rather than another hostlist-only edit.
